title: Setup [pt2]
description:
Setups almost done! Now, you need to do two things: grab the course starter files, and get the lessons!
---
Getting the starter files
To install the starter files, go [here](https://github.com/Youg-Otricked/lhc-learn-linux-starter), install the zip, unzip it, then, run these commands: 
### Linux/MacOS Users:
Open your terminal and type:
```
cd ~/Downloads
mv FILE_NAME ~
```

### Windows (WSL) Users:
Open WSL and type:
```
cd /mnt/c/Users/YOUR_USERNAME/Downloads
mv FILE_NAME ~
```
Replace YOUR_USERNAME with your Windows/MacOS/Linux username and FILE_NAME with the name of the extracted unziped file
---
### Installing the course
Just run `lhc upgrade`.
---
## Using the CLI
To see a list of commands, run `lhc help`. However, you wont need almost any of those commands right now, for now, to run a lesson you use `lhc run <HASH>` and to submit it, `lhc run <HASH> -s`. Run has less feedback but you won't fail the lesson on fail and submit has more feedback but a higher risk.
---
Just run the run/submit command. Once it says to visit a link, visit it then check back here to see if you pass.
